question: Which of the following schemes is aimed at better administration of Waqf properties and safeguarding and preventing the encroachment of these properties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qaumi Waqf Board Taraqqiati Scheme (QWBTS)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Islamic Waqf Board Taraqqiati Scheme (IWBTS):**

 
 
• IWBTS aims to improve Waqf property administration.
 
• Waqf properties are dedicated to charitable/religious purposes.
 
• The scheme prevents encroachment of Waqf properties.
